pages.observed: Option a frames 0 to 24 (0.0 to 0.8 s). Empty illustrated restaurant interior, no person visible. Left glass door ajar with bell above, host stand with phone and hanging dark apron at right, riverside landscape through window. Caption about the only server walking out appears at 0.6 s while no server figure is shown; door position changes at 0.8 s.

Option a 1.0 to 1.8 s. Door has shut flat in its frame; room otherwise identical to prior page. Host stand with phone, apron hanging at its side, empty floor. Caption band sits over the lower host stand and apron. No movement detectable across the five samples.

Option a 2.0 to 2.8 s. Wide room holds still while a Texas outline card draws in at top right. At 2.6 s cut to a close host stand: phone on top, open lined book with pencil, dark apron hanging from a hook on the front. At 2.8 s ring arcs appear beside the handset. Caption band overlaps the stand front and apron top.

Option a 3.0 to 3.8 s. Static close of the host stand while the desk phone pulses ring arcs and a yellow indicator; nobody answers. Apron hangs below the caption band, its top covered by the caption. Texas locator card completes outline with a small mark on the upper coast.

Option a 4.0 to 4.8 s. Same close host-stand framing continues. Phone keeps pulsing ring arcs. At 4.6 s the first caption clears, showing the full dark apron hanging motionless from its hook. No caption at 4.6 and 4.8 s. Same composition held since 2.6 s.

Option a 5.0 to 5.8 s. Wide dining room with two seated customers at separate tables in front of the window, plates in front of them. Host stand at right edge with blank lined book and phone pulsing. Seated figures are small, roughly 40 px tall within the 390 px frame. Second customer raises a hand at 5.8 s. Caption band low; floor empty.
Option a 6.0 to 6.8 s. Same wide room held. One customer keeps a hand raised, the phone keeps ringing, nobody arrives. Composition unchanged since 5.0 s apart from the raised arm and ring arcs.

Option a 7.0 to 7.8 s. Wide room hold ends with caption clearing at 7.4 s. At 7.8 s cut to front of the room: a white empty sign frame hangs in the window beside a dark unlit tablet panel on a pole stand, door at left, host stand and apron at right. Disclosure label changes to the panel disclosure.

Option a 8.0 to 8.8 s. Front-of-house framing held. Blank white sign frame swings a little on its wire and settles, nothing pinned in it. Dark tablet panel on stand stays unlit. Caption The family didn't post a job ad. appears at 8.2 s, sitting below the stand base.
Option a 9.0 to 9.8 s. Same front-of-house frame with the empty sign frame hanging still and the black panel unlit. Nothing moves across the five samples. This framing has now held from 7.8 s.

Option a 10.0 to 10.8 s. Same front-of-house frame continues unchanged; the panel has not lit. Caption clears at 10.6 s. Static composition from roughly 8.8 s to 10.8 s, about 2 s with no visible change.

Option a 11.0 to 11.8 s. Close shot of the stand-mounted panel. Screen wipes on left to right in teal, a ring icon appears and the name Haniya writes across it by 11.8 s, with the final letter partly cut by the screen edge in that frame. Caption sits over the pole below the panel.
Option a 12.0 to 12.8 s. Lit Haniya panel held centered on its stand with the name fully legible. No further motion in these five samples; no AI host tag yet.

Option a 13.0 to 13.8 s. After a hold, framing tightens on the panel at 13.4 s and a tilted paper tag reading AI host swings in from the right on a string, hanging beside the upper right corner of the panel by 13.8 s. Tag is near the frame edge and does not visibly touch the panel. Caption overlaps the lower panel bezel in the tighter framing.

Option a 14.0 to 14.8 s. The AI host tag lands on the panel face at its upper right corner, overlapping the ring icon edge, then settles with a slight tilt. Panel name remains legible; caption overlaps the lower bezel.

Option a 15.0 to 15.8 s. Panel-with-tag hold ends; caption clears at 15.4 s. At 15.6 s cut to a tabletop: a square code card on a small stand, plate and glass, and a phone held by a hand rising from the bottom edge with the code visible on its screen. Phone occupies the lower quarter, partly cropped by the frame bottom.

Option a 16.0 to 16.8 s. A forearm in a blue sleeve lifts the phone up from the frame bottom until the phone is held in front of and covering the code card at 16.8 s. The phone screen showed the code image throughout, including before it reached the card. At 16.4 s the phone passes under the caption band. No viewfinder lock indicator seen yet.

Option a 17.0 to 17.8 s. Arm and phone held steady in front of the code card; phone screen shows the code framed by viewfinder corners. At 17.8 s a small red/pink bar starts at the base of the screen. Little motion otherwise. Arm passes behind the caption band.

Option a 18.0 to 18.8 s. On the held phone the code image is replaced by a menu that slides up: white rows with small dish icons and a dark Pay pill at the bottom. Menu text is tiny at 390 px width. The phone screen occupies roughly 70 by 130 px. No fingertip yet.

Option a 19.0 to 19.8 s. Cut to a close, legible phone held in the left hand. A right index finger reaches in, touches the Chow mein row at 19.6 s and the row lights yellow at 19.8 s. Menu shows a Talk mic button and a Pay button. Fingertip partly covers the row label during contact. Caption sits low over the wrist.

Option a 20.0 to 20.8 s. After the tap the right hand withdraws quickly; at 20.2 s only a fingertip shape is visible at the right edge, then the hand is gone. The yellow Chow mein row stays highlighted and legible. Talk button is visible but never used.

Option a 21.0 to 21.8 s. Close phone with lit Chow mein row holds with no caption until 21.4 s, then the framing pulls back slightly. A right hand rises from the bottom right toward the Pay button; at 21.8 s the fingertip is just below the phone. Pay button is small at this framing.

Option a 22.0 to 22.8 s. A finger presses the Pay button and a white Paid card with a red check pops up on the screen at 22.4 s; the button also now reads Paid with a check. The hand withdraws and the Paid result holds to 22.8 s. Paid mark is clearly readable at phone size.

Option a 23.0 to 23.8 s. Paid card holds on the phone, then cut at 23.6 s to a kitchen pass: a black thermal printer on a steel counter with an empty ticket rail above, and an empty black wok on an unlit three-knob burner beside it. No cook or person visible.

Option a 24.0 to 24.8 s. Static wide kitchen pass with idle printer and cold wok while the caption reads Nothing is cooked until the order is paid for. At 24.6 s cut to the hand-held phone with its Paid card at left and the printer on a shelf at right; at 24.8 s a dashed red arc starts from the phone toward the printer slot. Phone and printer appear in the same frame without a stated physical connection.

Option a 25.0 to 25.8 s. A red check token travels along a dashed arc from the phone into the printer's top slot; on arrival the printer's lamp turns red. At 25.8 s cut closer to the printer with its red lamp lit; caption covers the printer's lower front. No ticket yet.

Option a 26.0 to 26.8 s. A ticket marked with a red check and Chow mein prints up out of the printer toward the rail. Cut to the wide pass at 26.6 s: ticket stands above the printer, a white-sleeved arm from the right edge tips a bowl into the wok at 26.8 s and the burner flames. Cook is only an arm from off-frame; ticket landing on the rail is not clearly shown.

Option a 27.0 to 27.8 s. Wide pass: wok now full of noodles over high flames, the Chow mein ticket stands above the printer. The cook appears only as a white sleeve and hand at the right frame edge, first lifting the empty bowl away, then holding the wok handle. Caption clears at 27.2 s.

Option a 28.0 to 28.8 s. Back-office desk shot: wall with a small corkboard, blue mug at left, and a lined paper card sliding in from the right whose small heading reads Saving or winning back. Card is small in frame and partly off-screen through 28.6 s. Large dark desk-front area fills the lower half beneath the caption.

Option a 29.0 to 29.8 s. The ledger card settles on the desk; its small heading reads Saving or winning back and its ruled rows are empty. The dollar figure appears only in the caption so far. Card occupies roughly one fifth of the frame height; lower half is dark desk front.

Option a 30.0 to 30.8 s. Cut to a closer ledger card at 30.2 s. A kraft tag reading $9,650 a month swings in from the upper right and lands on the card's upper right corner at 30.8 s, partly covering the heading word back. Figure on the tag matches the caption and is legible.
Option a 31.0 to 31.8 s. The tag settles onto the ledger card's right half and the full heading Saving or winning back becomes readable; then a static hold. Card rows remain blank.

Option a 32.0 to 32.8 s. Card-with-tag hold, caption clears at 32.4 s, then a closer framing at 32.6 s and a large wooden rubber stamp comes down onto the card's heading at 32.8 s. The stamp handle top overlaps the disclosure label area at upper left.

Option a 33.0 to 33.8 s. Stamp presses and lifts, leaving a crooked red OWNER COUNT imprint on the ledger card under the $9,650 a month tag. At 33.6 s cut to a wide back office with a window and corkboard; the stamped card is small at lower left. No receipt clip is identifiable in this wide frame.

Option a 34.0 to 34.8 s. Static wide back-office view from 33.6 s: window, corkboard with a small dark hanging object (bag or clip), mug and the small stamped card. No visible change. The board's bare receipt clip is not recognizable as such at phone size; the hanging object reads as a small bag.

Option a 35.0 to 35.8 s. New shot: an arm holds the paid phone at upper left over a kitchen counter with an empty-ish glass tip jar and a cooking wok at right. At 35.6 to 35.8 s small coin and bill shapes pop out of the phone screen and fly toward the jar. The arm is a long rigid diagonal from the frame bottom.

Option a 36.0 to 36.8 s. A stream of coins and bills arcs from the paid phone across the kitchen into the glass jar. Cut at 36.6 s to a close jar as coins and a bill fall through the mouth and the pile inside grows. Coins pass the jar rim without bouncing.

Option a 37.0 to 37.8 s. The jar visibly fills with coins and bills over these frames. At 37.8 s the framing changes to a larger jar low in frame; the caption band now covers the jar's middle. No tag yet.

Option a 38.0 to 38.8 s. A kraft tag reading FOX 26 reports all to the kitchen swings in from the right and settles hanging on the jar's upper half above the caption band. Tag text is legible. Caption still covers the jar's lower middle.

Option a 39.0 to 39.8 s. Jar with tag holds and the caption clears at 39.4 s, leaving the jar fully visible. At 39.6 s cut to an almost empty desk with only the edge of a white card at the right frame edge; the frame is mostly bare wood and wall.

Option a 40.0 to 40.8 s. A Federal tip pool rule card slides in from the right and settles mid-frame at 40.8 s. Its rows read If the employer takes no tip credit (with a box outline) and a tip pool may include cooks (with a chef hat icon). Card is legible at phone size; large bare desk and dark desk front fill the rest.
Option a 41.0 to 41.8 s. Rule card sits still on the desk; checkbox empty, chef hat icon by the cooks line. No change across the five samples.

Option a 42.0 to 42.8 s. Rule card holds unchanged from about 40.8 s to 42.6 s, roughly 1.8 s, with the box still empty. At 42.8 s cut to a closer view; a thin yellow highlight begins at the left of the cooks row.

Option a 43.0 to 43.8 s. Close, legible rule card; a yellow marker highlight sweeps across the a tip pool may include cooks row up to the chef hat icon. The no tip credit box stays empty. Card fills the upper third; caption below.

Option a 44.0 to 44.8 s. A hand in a purple sleeve with a pen reaches in from the bottom, its forearm covering the card for about 0.4 s, and draws a dark arc that loops over the no tip credit row and the box toward the cooks row. At 44.8 s the hand is gone and the partial loop remains; it reads as a single arc rather than a closed circle in this frame. Box stays empty.

Option a 45.0 to 45.8 s. A closed oval now circles both the no tip credit row with its box and the highlighted cooks row. The pen hand returns and parks at the top left with its forearm across the card, covering half of the row text through the end of the scene; the box remains empty.

Option a 46.0 to 46.8 s. Wider desk view with the circled rule card cropped at the left edge. A manila folder with a small Restaurant tab slides in from the right starting at 46.6 s. Large empty desk area between the two; the rule card's text is cut off by the frame.

Option a 47.0 to 47.8 s. The Restaurant folder settles, then a closer shot shows it opening: its cover slides aside to reveal a sheet reading Takes no tip credit? with an empty checkbox and blank lines. Legible at phone size.
Option a 48.0 to 48.8 s. Open folder sheet reading Takes no tip credit? with an empty box; a question mark fades in beside the box and becomes bold by 48.8 s. Clear and legible above the caption.

Option a 49.0 to 49.8 s. Folder with question mark holds then cut at 49.4 s to the same table-code setup as scene 3: code card on a stand and a phone in a hand, tilted, with the code dim on its screen. The hand appears to drift down slightly by 49.8 s. Caption covers the phone's lower screen at 49.8 s.

Option a 50.0 to 50.8 s. The hand raises the phone toward and above the code card, wavers, then lowers it to the bottom of the frame by 50.8 s. The screen shows the code image during the raise; no lock or menu appears. Reads as a hesitant lift and lower. Same table, phone and arm design as scene 3, so the person's identity is ambiguous.

Option a 51.0 to 51.8 s. After the lowered phone, cut to a medium view: the phone now lies on the table beside the code card with no hand, and a quote card reading "not very convenient for every kind of people" / One customer slides in from the right and settles above the table line. Small but legible. Hand disappears across the cut.

Option a 52.0 to 52.8 s. The quote card lands on the table beside the code card and the lowered phone, then holds. The three objects sit in a narrow band at mid-frame; the upper half is blank wall and lower third blank table. The quote text is small (about 9 px tall) but readable.

Option a 53.0 to 53.8 s. Quote-card setup holds static from about 52.2 s to 53.6 s. At 53.8 s cut to the closing room: the lit Haniya panel on its stand at left and, across the room on a steel counter, a full tip jar and the ticket printer. Jar and printer are small at right.

Option a 54.0 to 54.8 s. In the closing room view, an order card reading Chow mein with a red check appears on the Haniya panel, then a small ticket arcs on a dashed line from the panel toward the printer on the counter. Ticket and jar are small at phone size.

Option a 55.0 to 55.8 s. The ticket from the panel arcs into the printer, the lamp turns red and a ticket prints upward with a red check. The panel keeps the Chow mein row. Printer and ticket are small (around 40 px) on the right half of the frame.

Option a 56.0 to 56.8 s. Closing room view holds with the printed ticket on the printer. At 56.8 s cut to a close full tip jar on the counter and the edge of a white tag starting with Ow entering from the right.

Option a 57.0 to 57.8 s. A white tag reading owner says swings in from the right on a string and settles hanging on the full jar's shoulder by 57.8 s. Tag legible; jar sits just above the caption band.

Option a 58.0 to 58.8 s. Close jar with owner says tag, then cut at 58.4 s to a wide room with the Haniya panel and the tagged jar both small. A second tag partly reading record shown swings in from the left near the panel stand, on the opposite side of the frame from the jar. Panel and jar text are small at this width.

Option a 59.0 to 59.8 s. The no record shown tag swings across the frame from the panel side and settles hanging just below the owner says tag on the jar. Both tags legible at phone size; jar contents are mostly hidden by the two tags. Panel remains visible at left.

Option a 60.0 to 60.8 s. Final story image holds about 0.6 s without caption: panel at left, jar at right carrying owner says and no record shown tags. At 60.6 s cut to the dark credits card with the current Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL, sources and illustration note.
Option a 61.0 to 61.8 s. Static credits card, identical across all five samples.
Option a 62.0 to 62.8 s. Same static credits card as the previous page; no change.
Option a 63.0 to 63.8 s. Unchanged static credits card.
Option a 64.0 to 64.8 s. Unchanged static credits card.
Option a 65.0 to 65.433 s (final phone frame 1963). Unchanged static credits card through the last frame; option a sequence complete.

Option b 0.0 to 0.8 s. Overhead floor plan of a restaurant: two round tables with three seated diners, a host stand by the door at left, a steel counter at right. From 0.2 s a trail of footprints runs from the host stand out through the door, which swings open. No standing figure shown; the walk-out is shown by footprints. Plan fills upper half; lower half is blank cream.

Option b 1.0 to 1.8 s. Overhead plan holds while the door swings shut after the footprint trail that exits the room. Small ring marks by the door hinge suggest the bell. Diners stay seated. Caption sits just under the plan.

Option b 2.0 to 2.8 s. Plan holds while the Texas locator card draws in; at 2.6 s cut to an eye-level host stand with a desk phone and an empty dark apron hanging on its front, door and bell at left, window behind. No ring indication yet. Caption overlaps the apron.
Option b 3.0 to 3.8 s. Medium host-stand view holds; at 3.6 s ring arcs appear on both sides of the desk phone and nobody answers. Empty apron hangs on the stand. Texas outline finishes drawing.

Option b 4.0 to 4.8 s. Same host-stand view; phone keeps pulsing ring arcs, the empty apron hangs still and nobody arrives. Caption clears at 4.6 s, revealing the full stand and apron. Texas locator shows a small coastal mark.

Option b 5.0 to 5.8 s. Close shot over the host stand: a blank lined order pad with pencil in the foreground, the ringing phone at left, and two waiting diners behind, one raising a hand by 5.8 s. Diners are about 70 to 100 px tall and readable. Caption crosses the stand's front.
Option b 6.0 to 6.8 s. Same close framing held: blank pad in front, phone ringing at left, a diner holding a raised hand behind. Little change apart from the raised hand and ring arcs.

Option b 7.0 to 7.8 s. Waiting-diner close shot holds and the caption clears at 7.4 s. At 7.8 s cut to a wide front-of-house view: door with bell, an empty white sign frame hanging in the window, a dark panel on a stand, the host stand with its apron, and one small seated diner. Texas locator stays at top right.

Option b 8.0 to 8.8 s. Wide front-of-house view; the empty sign frame swings slightly and settles with nothing in it while the panel stays dark. Caption The family didn't post a job ad. sits on the floor area. Lower 40 percent of frame is empty floor.
Option b 9.0 to 9.8 s. Front-of-house wide view unchanged across all five samples; the frame hangs empty and the panel stays dark.
Option b 10.0 to 10.8 s. Same wide front-of-house view; caption clears at 10.6 s. Composition has been static since about 8.6 s, roughly 2.2 s without visible change.

Option b 11.0 to 11.8 s. Medium shot of the stand-mounted panel beside the host stand. The screen wipes on in teal from the left, a ring icon appears and the name Haniya writes across by 11.8 s. The panel sits beside the same host stand and apron seen in scene 1.
Option b 12.0 to 12.8 s. Lit Haniya panel held beside the host stand and empty apron; no change across samples.

Option b 13.0 to 13.8 s. Cut to a large detail of the Haniya panel; a white AI host tag swings in from the upper left on a string and reaches the panel's top-left corner by 13.8 s. Panel name large and legible; caption crosses the lower bezel.
Option b 14.0 to 14.8 s. The AI host tag lands and pins at the upper right of the Haniya panel face, then holds. Panel name and tag both legible; caption overlaps the lower bezel.

Option b 15.0 to 15.8 s. Panel-with-tag hold ends; at 15.6 s cut to an overhead table with a code card in a stand, plate, menu, chopsticks and glass, and a phone held at lower left whose screen already shows the code. Phone is below the table edge, not over the card.

Option b 16.0 to 16.8 s. Overhead table; the arm lifts the phone up from the bottom, passing behind the caption band at 16.2 s, and moves it over the code card by 16.8 s. The phone screen shows the code image throughout the approach. No lock indicator yet.

Option b 17.0 to 17.8 s. From above, the phone is held over and covering the code card, its screen showing the code in a viewfinder. At 17.8 s a small red/pink bar begins at the screen's bottom. The arm runs from the frame bottom through the caption band.

Option b 18.0 to 18.8 s. From above, the menu slides up over the code image on the held phone and fills the screen with dish rows and a dark Pay button. Menu text is tiny at this overhead scale (screen roughly 70 by 130 px).

Option b 19.0 to 19.8 s. Cut to an over-the-shoulder view of a seated guest with a hair bun and blue top holding the phone; the guest's right index finger taps the Chow mein row, which lights yellow at 19.8 s. The guest's whole upper body, both arms and chair are shown. Menu row text is small but the yellow highlight reads.

Option b 20.0 to 20.8 s. The guest lifts her finger after the tap and the Chow mein row stays lit yellow. Her right hand stays raised beside the phone. The arm is drawn attached through shoulder, elbow and hand.

Option b 21.0 to 21.8 s. After a short hold, cut to a detail of the phone in hand: the Chow mein row is lit at top and a large Pay button sits at the bottom, all legible. The disclosure label overlaps the phone's upper rows. A fingertip enters from lower right at 21.8 s.

Option b 22.0 to 22.8 s. In close detail a finger presses the large Pay button; at 22.4 s a big Paid card with a red check appears and the button reads Paid. The finger withdraws and the Paid result holds, large and legible.

Option b 23.0 to 23.8 s. Paid result holds, then cut to a wide kitchen pass with an idle ticket printer under an empty rail and an empty wok on an unlit burner. No person present. Lower 35 percent of the frame is floor.

Option b 24.0 to 24.8 s. Kitchen pass holds idle, then at 24.6 s cut to the overhead floor plan from scene 1 where a phone with a red check now lies on the lower table; at 24.8 s a dashed red path runs from that phone across the floor to the printer on the counter. Only one diner remains at each table; the upper table's second diner and the lower diner's raised hand from the opening are not present.

Option b 25.0 to 25.8 s. Overhead camera pushes in as a red check token travels along a dashed path from the phone on the table to the printer on the counter, entering its slot at 25.4 s; the printer lamp turns red. At 25.8 s cut to an eye-level close printer with its red lamp and an empty rail above. The token path passes over the round burner element from above.

Option b 26.0 to 26.8 s. A Chow mein ticket with a red check prints up and reaches the rail; cut to a detail where a white-sleeved arm tips a bowl of noodles into the wok and flames appear under it at 26.8 s. Cook is an arm from the right edge only. Ticket stays visible above.

Option b 27.0 to 27.8 s. The bowl lifts away and the noodles toss in the flaming wok twice while a hand holds the wok handle from the right edge. The Chow mein ticket stays visible on the printer above throughout.

Option b 28.0 to 28.8 s. Overhead empty desk for about 0.4 s, then a ruled ledger card headed Saving or winning back slides in from the right edge, still half off-frame at 28.8 s. Lower 40 percent of the frame is blank cream.
Option b 29.0 to 29.8 s. Overhead: the ledger card slides to the center of the desk and settles with a slight tilt; heading legible, table blank. The dollar figure is only in the caption so far.

Option b 30.0 to 30.8 s. Cut to a closer ledger card; a kraft tag reading $9,650 a month slides in from the right and pins onto the card's right half by 30.8 s. Card is cropped at left edge; tag text large and legible.
Option b 31.0 to 31.8 s. Tag settles on the ledger card and holds with a slight sway; heading and figure legible.

Option b 32.0 to 32.8 s. Card-with-tag holds, then a detail framing where a large wooden rubber stamp swings in from the upper right and comes down across the card's middle at 32.8 s, partly covering the tag.

Option b 33.0 to 33.8 s. The stamp presses and lifts leaving a crooked red OWNER COUNT imprint on the card. At 33.6 s cut to a medium back-office view: corkboard with a hanging black bag-like object, window, mug and the stamped card small on the desk. No receipt clip is identifiable; the corkboard object reads as a handbag.
Option b 34.0 to 34.8 s. Static back-office medium shot from 33.6 s; card small on the desk, corkboard object ambiguous (bag or clip). No visible change. Lower 40 percent is dark desk front.

Option b 35.0 to 35.8 s. Overhead view of the kitchen pass with the wok, printer and a round jar; the paid phone lies on the counter edge. From 35.2 s coins and a bill emerge from the phone and travel toward the jar. Objects are small (jar about 40 px across) and the lower half of the frame is blank cream.

Option b 36.0 to 36.8 s. From above, a chain of coins and a bill runs from the paid phone into the jar. At 36.6 s cut to eye level: coins and a bill drop from the top of the frame into a glass jar on the pass beside the printer still holding the Chow mein ticket, and the jar begins to fill.
Option b 37.0 to 37.8 s. The jar beside the printer visibly fills with coins and bills, then at 37.8 s cut to a close jar; the caption band crosses the jar's middle in that frame.

Option b 38.0 to 38.8 s. A kraft tag reading FOX 26 reports all to the kitchen swings in from the left and settles on the jar's shoulder, legible above the caption. Caption covers the jar's lower half and coins.
Option b 39.0 to 39.8 s. Jar with tag holds; caption clears at 39.4 s revealing the full jar. At 39.6 s cut to an empty overhead desk with only a card edge at the right border.

Option b 40.0 to 40.8 s. Overhead: the Federal tip pool rule card slides onto the desk and settles; at 40.8 s a checkbox outline is being drawn at the no tip credit row. Card text legible; desk otherwise empty.
Option b 41.0 to 41.8 s. Rule card on desk with its empty checkbox now fully drawn; no change across samples.
Option b 42.0 to 42.8 s. Overhead rule card holds unchanged from about 41.0 s to 42.6 s; at 42.8 s cut to a closer card with a faint highlight starting at the cooks row. Box empty.
Option b 43.0 to 43.8 s. Close, legible rule card; a yellow highlight sweeps across the cooks row to the chef hat icon. Empty box remains.

Option b 44.0 to 44.8 s. A purple-sleeved hand enters with a pen, covering half the card for about 0.2 s, and draws an arc starting left of no tip credit, arching over the row toward the box. The forearm crosses the card from the lower edge. Box stays empty.

Option b 45.0 to 45.8 s. A closed oval circles both rule rows and the empty box; the pen hand parks at the top left corner over the title's first letters, with the forearm out of frame. Row text stays readable.

Option b 46.0 to 46.8 s. Wide overhead desk with the circled rule card fully visible at upper left; a manila Restaurant folder begins sliding in from the right at 46.8 s. Rule card text is small at this width.
Option b 47.0 to 47.8 s. The Restaurant folder settles beside the circled rule card, then a close shot shows the folder opening to a sheet reading Takes no tip credit? with an empty box. Legible.
Option b 48.0 to 48.8 s. Open folder sheet with an empty box; a question mark fades in beside the box and is bold by 48.8 s. Legible above the caption.

Option b 49.0 to 49.8 s. Folder with question mark holds, then cut to the same overhead table setup as scene 3 with a phone held tilted below the table edge, its screen showing the code. The phone sits under the caption band at 49.8 s.

Option b 50.0 to 50.8 s. From above, the hand lifts the phone toward the code card, stops short of it, then pulls back; the phone screen greys out as it lowers. No lock or menu appears. Same arm, sleeve and phone design as the scene 3 guest.

Option b 51.0 to 51.8 s. The phone stays lowered with a dim screen while a quote card reading "not very convenient for every kind of people" / One customer slides in from the left and lands over the table's upper area, partly covering the code card and plate. Quote legible at phone size.
Option b 52.0 to 52.8 s. Quote card rests beside the code card; the phone stays lowered with a dimmed screen and the code stays unscanned. Static hold across the remaining samples.

Option b 53.0 to 53.8 s. Quote-card table holds while the phone screen goes dark, then cut to a wide room with the lit Haniya panel large at left and the printer and full tip jar on a steel counter at right. Jar and printer are small.

Option b 54.0 to 54.8 s. On the large Haniya panel a Chow mein order card with a red check appears, then a small ticket arcs on a dashed line from the panel toward the printer on the counter. Panel order card legible; printer and jar small.

Option b 55.0 to 55.8 s. The ticket from the panel lands in the printer, the lamp lights red and a ticket with a red check prints up. Panel keeps the Chow mein order card. Printer ticket is small (about 15 px).

Option b 56.0 to 56.8 s. Closing room view holds with the ticket printed, then cut to a medium shot of the pass with the printer still holding the Chow mein ticket next to a filled glass jar; a tag edge enters from the right at 56.8 s.
